parts.title: Goal
text: A chatbot which uses the Le Chat API and answers with my provided information.

parts.title: Le Chat
text: The local use of mistral was way to slow. Especialy running on a raspberry pi.
Once I realized there is an european version of a quite fast Large Language AI provider I wanted to try it and update my chatbot!

parts.title: ChromaDB
text: To store the knowledge which is provided by the bot, I use the chromaDB. This is a database which creates vectors out of phrases. As soon the user inserts something into the chat it generates a vector and searches for similar entries insde chroma.
Once it finds those similarities (below a certain threshold) it can provide the correct phrases which we can use in our prompt to generate an answer based on the provided information

parts.title: Flask
text: I used Flask to create access to the chatbot and provide it as an HTTP service.
